model.name: TaskStatus.assertStatusConsistent
model.description: FAIL-LOUD detector: for every Task assert model.status == deriveStatusEnum(model.statusChecklist); exit 1 LISTING every offender, and FLAG the DANGEROUS subset status='Done' && Done-box UNCHECKED as FALSE-DONE priority (the S33-36 honesty-audit target); also flag the 1 malformed (non-string) checklist. NEVER auto-flips a status (INV-S5a no-invention) — the list IS the planner's honest-Done audit worklist; resolution flows checklist->status only, owner-resolved at the task level. Fold into ci:gates (composes with R-C3). R-C5. Design-ahead -> expert marks the decl; scripts/CI-only, NO restart/version-bump.
